label: My return: foreign income - the rules

params.name: heads
params.label: foreign income by head: where it joins the return (salary - Schedule S; house - Schedule HP, the 30% and interest; interest / dividend / other - Schedule OS; a short-term gain at the slab rates, a long-term gain at 12.5% u/s 112 - Schedule CG; business - a CA) and its Schedule FSI block

params.name: relief_secs
params.label: s.90 (a DTAA with the country), s.90A (an agreement between specified associations), s.91 (no agreement)

params.name: dtaa_secs
params.label: Schedule TR: relief where a DTAA applies (the rest is s.91)

params.name: rate_rule
params.label: the foreign income is typed in rupees - rule 115: at the SBI telegraphic-transfer buying rate on the last day of the month before the month the income is received / accrues (salary, interest, dividend)

params.name: form67
params.label: rule 128(9): Form 67 (with proof of the foreign tax) is filed on the e-filing portal on or before the end of the AY - 31 March 2027 - for the relief to be allowed

description_nl: 2026-10-07: Foreign income for AY 2026-27: where each head joins the return, the relief sections (90 / 90A / 91), the rupee rate (rule 115) and Form 67 (rule 128).
